import copy

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path('/Users/dylan/.codex/worktrees/native-analytic-frames/shardloom-local-repo')
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts'))
from ci_native_tests import discover, partition_tests, verify_coverage

HEAD = 'd56499bc4fd5904f6e3ffe6993dd687ae666c34a'
PROBE = 'local_primitives::prepared_relational::tests::grouped_cost_tests::native_grouped_cost_attribution'
EXE = Path('/Users/dylan/.cache/shardloom/cargo-target/ci-native/deps/shardloom_vortex-3a84e4520be877a1')
BASE = '.github/ci-native-baseline.json'
old = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', HEAD + ':' + BASE], cwd=ROOT))
new = json.loads((ROOT / BASE).read_text())
expected = copy.deepcopy(old)
expected['ignored_tests'] = sorted([*old['ignored_tests'], PROBE])
assert new == expected, 'only the declared manual probe may be added'
tests = discover(EXE)
ignored = discover(EXE, ignored=True)
assert set(ignored) - set(old['ignored_tests']) == {PROBE}
assert not set(old['ignored_tests']) - set(ignored)
try:
    partition_tests(tests, ignored, old)
except ValueError as error:
    assert str(error) == 'native ignored-test policy changed'
else:
    raise AssertionError('original rejection was not reproduced')
plan = partition_tests(tests, ignored, new)
verify_coverage(tests, plan)
assert sum(PROBE in part['tests'] for part in plan) == 1
log = OUT / 'hosted-grouped-state-build-failure.log'
assert 'native ignored-test policy changed' in log.read_text()
digest = lambda value: hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
record = dict(schema_version='shardloom.grouped_state_ci_inventory_correction.v1', status='passed',

    baseline_after_sha256=digest((ROOT / BASE).read_bytes()),
    test_executable_sha256=digest(EXE.read_bytes()), complete_test_inventory=tests,

    complete_once_only_coverage=True, unchanged_runtime_source=True,
    query_executions=0, manual_probe_executions=0)
destination = ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/native-grouped-state-ci-correction-2026-10-31.json'
assert not destination.exists()
destination.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(status='passed', discovered=len(tests), ignored=len(ignored), partitions=len(plan),
    original_rejection_reproduced=True, query_executions=0)))
